batch-02.evidence: save() re-reads the file and merges keys this store never touched before writing (read-merge-write with sibling-store comment); removed-intent tombstones preserved. Verified 2026-10-14.
load() emits config:changed for every reset and set (with before/after/liveSafe), so subscribers see loaded values. Verified 2026-10-14.

poll() has an in-flight guard (this.polling), generation checks after each await, and stop() bumps generation + clears polling; a stopped service cannot be resurrected by an in-flight pass. Verified 2026-10-14.
heldUnavailable is captured separately and wins the final unavailable-on-this-device classification over a later unrelated failure (batch-02 fix).
freezeHoldIntent(held) now freezes while held and resumes at the next bar on release; a momentary press no longer latches the master frozen (batch-02 fix, test updated).

templateFor resolves dynamic families (device transportMode/transportOrder, ui.shortcuts.*, qa.faults.*) through their template rows; defineKey accepts concrete keys under each pattern. Verified 2026-10-14.
redactSecretText deduplicates and replaces longest-first, so a substring secret cannot shield part of a longer one. Verified 2026-10-14.
toBase64/fromBase64 prefer Buffer behind a typeof guard and fall back to the browser globals, so the module loads in either runtime. Verified 2026-10-14.
The bundle loop throws on element overrun and on any trailing 1-3 residual bytes (reported malformed, never thrown at the caller). Verified 2026-10-14.

batch-01.evidence: openStream now closes the predecessor ToolkitStream before the map overwrite (commit 7818983); the cited stream-creation lines remain as part of the fixed flow.
metrics no longer echo requested rates (measured effectiveHz) and health() reports a stopped/errored emitter as degraded via bindingStream.error (commits 65b5ea6/7818983).
Publish path resets metricsWindowStartNs and missedTicks per rolling window (comment on the reset, index.ts ~710); getMetrics stays side-effect free. Verified 2026-10-14.
composeFrames resets lastWeights to {a:0,b:0} when nothing audible and {a:1,b:0} in the single-deck branch. Verified 2026-10-14.
handlePortGone sets crashFired, calls onCrash, then stop() (clears interval, closes bus) with a comment. Verified 2026-10-14.
Received-at bigint is the in-process form with an explicit comment; wireDeckStateSchema below carries the JSON-safe decimal string for IPC/worker boundaries. Verified 2026-10-14.
trackModelSchema superRefine enforces section/phrase startBeat<=endBeat, musical event span vs grid, and readinessLevel === analysisCoverage2.level. Verified 2026-10-14.
start() calls this.drain() after spawning workers (HEAD index.ts:122). Verified 2026-10-14.

stop() clears the heartbeat timer, rejects in-flight promises (clearing job timers) and nulls lastHeartbeat so armed callbacks cannot resurrect the supervisor (HEAD index.ts:248-262). Verified 2026-10-14.
start() and spawnOne() stamp lastHeartbeat as the grace window; checkHeartbeat guards null frames/empty procs (HEAD index.ts:119,163,489). Verified 2026-10-14.
